title: Fourth Time Meeting My Best FRIEND 🤝
description:
In this town every friendship builds a little bridge between two windows, one plank at a time. Burn it, and you both forget the other one ever lived.

This spring I met the guy across the alley, and in a week he was my best friend. Our bridge grew faster than anyone's, and three burnt bridges are lying in the alley under it, all running from his window to mine.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
